Data Bank

Title and RequirementsDetails
First Meeting
First Meeting▶ Ahem! Hello, (Trailblazer). Welcome aboard the Astral Express. My name is March 7th, I'm one of the passengers. We'll be working together. First, we need to take your induction photo... Did that scare you! Just a joke~
Greeting
Greeting▶ Ah! You're just in time — we haven't taken our selfie today.
Parting
Parting▶ I'm gonna get some rest after I've sorted these photos. Don't stay up all night playing video games again!
About Self: Name
About Self: Name▶ I came up with my name myself, but some people just call me March... Which do you prefer?
About Self: Past
About Self: Past▶ Maybe my past isn't behind me, but in front of me. That's why I'm gonna keep going forward, one stop at a time... train or no train.
Chat: Juice
Chat: Juice▶ Ahh, juice... If I say the word, I get a craving. If I get a craving, I wanna drink some. And if I drink some... Ahh... I can't stop!
Chat: Photos
Chat: Photos▶ Of course photos aren't reality, but if you have enough of them, doesn't reality come a little closer?
Hobbies
Hobbies▶ Taking pictures. Writing in my diary. What else is there to say~?
Annoyances
Annoyances▶ I get really bored when no one's talking to me. When we're on the Express, Himeko and Mr. Yang are pretty busy, but Dan Heng's usually free. He doesn't like chatting though...
Something to Share
Something to Share▶ Every time I'm done sorting my album and look out the window, I always want to take another picture... Even though I've seen the view a thousand times, I still feel happy looking at the stars like this.
Sharing: Sword Training
March to Mastery: A Star Is Born
Sharing: Sword Training
March to Mastery: A Star Is Born
▶ I'm a huge fan of the Xianzhou's immersia — I've always felt like a hero at heart. When I really started learning the art of the sword, I realized that the heroes in the immersia are nothing compared to my two little masters who taught me every sword technique I know!
Knowledge
Knowledge▶ No matter how disgusting the dish, you gotta summon your trailblazing spirit and face it! Not gonna lie though, jellied eels and Himeko's coffee are pretty tough to stomach...
About Dan Heng
About Dan Heng▶ ...Dan Heng got on the train before me. He never mentioned his past... If you get the chance, why don't you ask him about it?
About Dan Heng 2
About Dan Heng 2▶ Even after we found out about his mysterious past, he's still the same Dan Heng we've always known!
About Himeko
About Himeko▶ Ahh, beautiful Himeko. She's sensible, reliable, and elegant. It's great to have her as the navigator... When I'm grown up, I'm gonna be just like her! I like the now me too though~
About Welt
About Welt▶ I heard Mr. Yang was once the leader of a secret organization and saved a whole planet! Not to mention he's been a teacher, and even a storyboard artist! *sigh* He must be an alien or something...
About Pom-Pom
About Pom-Pom▶ The conductor is the best!
About Yanqing
March to Mastery: A Star Is Born
About Yanqing
March to Mastery: A Star Is Born
▶ Master Yanqing has very rigorous teaching style. He's always saying "that's what the general taught me back in the day," ...Looks like everything General Jing Yuan taught him he knows by heart.
About Yunli
March to Mastery: A Star Is Born
About Yunli
March to Mastery: A Star Is Born
▶ Master Yunli has a very freestyle approach to teaching. The thing she always says to me is: "You just feel it!" Maybe that's what they call experiential guidance?
About Sunday
A New Venture on the Eighth Dawn
About Sunday
A New Venture on the Eighth Dawn
▶ I wonder how the conductor would react if they heard about his "seven rest days" proposal.
About Evernight
About Evernight▶ Sometimes I imagine myself being all cool, mysterious, elegant, and powerful, making enemies go flying with just a flick of the wrist... But I never thought that'd come true! Next time, I'm gonna use my own power to protect everyone!
About Dan Heng 3
About Dan Heng 3▶ We both made huge progress on this Amphoreus adventure, I'd say it's a draw! Hmm... wait. He made that progress way before I did, so... Okay okay, he wins... but just by a hair!
About Aglaea
About Aglaea▶ My daily style improved so much after Lady Aglaea gave me some pointers. As expected from everyone's guide and mentor!
About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon▶ Tribbie may be small, but they have lots of energy! I didn't want to disappoint them, so I practiced for a super long time and finally memorized Oronyx's prayer! You don't believe me? Hmph. I'll recite it for you then...
About Mydei
About Mydei▶ Mydeimos seems so... cool and aloof, but he's actually really friendly... How does that work? I don't really get it... Guess I just understand girls more than I understand guys, huh.
About Castorice
About Castorice▶ Miss Castorice makes soft and fragrant plushies, writes exhilarating stories, and even smells super nice every time she walks by... I learn so much every time I hang out with her.
About Anaxa
About Anaxa▶ I was, um, actually born with a fear of teachers... but he's the exception! Whenever I don't get a concept, he uses dromases as an analogy, and then I instantly get it!
About Hyacine
About Hyacine▶ I don't know how, but we became super good friends even though we haven't known each other for a long time. The last time I went to her courtyard, we talked about everything from Taikiyan to Amphoreus, and drank pots and pots of floral tea, and ate one honeycake after another. Little Ica even fell asleep... but we still didn't feel like that chat was long enough!
About Cipher
About Cipher▶ It's super fun to listen to Miss Cipher! She's told me at least eighty versions of the story of the Meow-Meow faith and the Woof-Woof faith. That's almost more than the number of backstories I've made up for myself!
About Hysilens
About Hysilens▶ The sound of Lady Hysilens's violin is more intoxicating than honey brews... Could it be that the trick to becoming elegant and beautiful is to learn a musical instrument? Hmm. It's time for me to learn something as well and improve myself!
About Cerydra
About Cerydra▶ My heart was in my throat when I played Aero-Chess with the Imperator! But not only did she allow me to take back my moves, she even seriously considered my suggestions... Hehe, I even managed to snag a win at the end!
About Phainon
About Phainon▶ He suffered through so much agony but still managed to stay true to his wish... I need to be able to do that, too!
About Cyrene
About Cyrene▶ I won't forget how Cyrene protected all the memories and kept watch over the future... because that's how we make all the sacrifices worthwhile!
Presevation Eidolon Activation
Presevation Eidolon Activation▶ Hee-hee, my past is gradually coming to light.
"The Hunt" Eidolon Activation
"The Hunt" Eidolon Activation▶ Finally! Some recognition for training my butt off!
Character Ascension
Character Ascension▶ Today me is even more awesome than yesterday me!
Max Level Reached
Max Level Reached▶ I'm all grown up! My real journey starts now!
Preservation Trace Activation
Preservation Trace Activation▶ That's right! I still have a few tricks up my sleeve~
"The Hunt" Trace Activation
"The Hunt" Trace Activation▶ You can never have enough skills! Let's train some more⁓
Added to Team With (Trailblazer)
Added to Team With (Trailblazer)▶ You're coming with? Hmph, I'm keeping score.
Added to Team With Dan Heng
Added to Team With Dan Heng▶ I'm gonna show them what I can really do... Huh? Why the weird face, Dan Heng?
Added to Team With Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae
Added to Team With Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae▶ I'm gonna show them what I can really do... Huh? Dan Heng, you better believe in me!
Added to Team With Himeko
Added to Team With Himeko▶ If push comes to shove, I'm counting on you, Himeko!
Added to Team With Welt
Added to Team With Welt▶ Mr Yang's here! Yeah! Did I just say that out loud?
Added to Team With Yunli
Added to Team With Yunli▶ Master Yunli, look at how hard I've been training!
Added to Team With Yanqing
Added to Team With Yanqing▶ Don't worry, Master Yanqing. I won't let you down!
Added to Team With Sunday
Added to Team With Sunday▶ Yeah! This looks way cooler than when you were using a baton!
Added to Team With Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
Added to Team With Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae▶ Seriously, Dan Heng? You kept your head down, worked hard, and then blew everyone away! I'm gonna do that too!
Added to Team With Aglaea
Added to Team With Aglaea▶ What do you think of this outfit, Lady Aglaea?
Added to Team With Tribbie
Added to Team With Tribbie▶ Lady Tribbie! I still remember all the prayers to Time!
Added to Team With Mydei
Added to Team With Mydei▶ Mm! I'm here to help, too!
Added to Team With Castorice
Added to Team With Castorice▶ When's the next installment? I'm totally hooked on your writings~
Added to Team With Anaxa
Added to Team With Anaxa▶ If I have questions later, could you please answer them?
Added to Team With Hyacine
Added to Team With Hyacine▶ Don't worry! I'll look after myself!
Added to Team With Cipher
Added to Team With Cipher▶ I wanna feel what it's like to fly, too!
Added to Team With Phainon
Added to Team With Phainon▶ Don't worry. The Nameless will forever stand with Amphoreus!
Added to Team With Hysilens
Added to Team With Hysilens▶ Hehe, I get to hear good music again!
Added to Team With Cerydra
Added to Team With Cerydra▶ I am ready, Imperator!
Added to Team With Cyrene
Added to Team With Cyrene▶ Cyrene! It's so hard to catch you~ Let's snap a group photo before anything else!
